C1695.title: 74% of Enterprises Have Publicly Exposed Storage or Misconfigurations in the Cloud
C1695.summary: In October 2024, a security report based on telemetry data from cloud security customers found that 74% of enterprises had publicly exposed storage or other misconfigurations, creating opportunities for attackers. The report identified storage bucket misconfigurations as a leading source of cloud vulnerabilities, accounting for about 16%, and referenced the 2017 historical data breach involving a U.S. Department of Defense contractor caused by an S3 bucket misconfiguration exposing sensitive data.
